zh.title: 霍尔木兹僵局：随着即期协议前景消退，油价走向何处
zh.summary: 油价交易商仍期待霍尔木兹海峡很快重新开放，但谈判陷入停滞，对即期协议的耐心正在消退，导致油价前景堪忧。

title: U.S. judge ends graft case against Indian billionaire Gautam Adani
summary: A U.S. federal judge approved the Department of Justice's dismissal of criminal corruption charges against Indian billionaire Gautam Adani, ending the graft investigation.
content: A U.S. federal judge has approved the Department of Justice's decision to dismiss the criminal probe against Indian billionaire Gautam Adani on graft charges.

zh.title: 美国法官终止针对印度亿万富翁高塔姆·阿达尼的贪污案
zh.summary: 美国联邦法官批准司法部撤销对印度亿万富翁高塔姆·阿达尼的刑事腐败指控，结束了此项调查。

title: Singapore revises its annual growth forecast sharply higher on AI-related boost
summary: Singapore more than doubled its 2026 GDP growth forecast to 4.5%-5.5%, driven primarily by a surge in AI-sector activity and related infrastructure expansion.
content: GDP growth for 2026 is now expected to come in at 4.5% to 5.5%, more than double the low end of its previous forecast of 2%-4%

zh.title: 新加坡因AI相关因素大幅上调年度增长预期
zh.summary: 新加坡将2026年GDP增长预期上调至4.5%-5.5%，较之前水平大幅提高，主要由AI产业活动激增和相关基础设施扩张驱动。

title: Nvidia teams with Wall Street firms to help finance $500 billion for AI infrastructure
summary: Nvidia announced a partnership with seven major Wall Street financial institutions to raise over $500 billion in third-party capital for global AI infrastructure development.
content: Nvidia late Monday announced a partnership with seven Wall Street financial institutions designed to raise more than $500 billion of third-party capital to fund the buildout of AI infrastructure.

zh.title: 英伟达与华尔街公司合作融资5000亿美元用于人工智能基础设施
zh.summary: 英伟达宣布与七家主要华尔街金融机构建立合作伙伴关系，为全球人工智能基础设施开发募集超过5000亿美元的第三方资本。

title: Trump claims total control of Hormuz, demands Iran pay reparations as standoff deepens
summary: Trump escalates the Strait of Hormuz standoff by claiming U.S. control and demanding reparations from Iran, as Washington and Tehran remain far apart despite rhetoric about de-escalation.
content: The dueling positions Washington and Tehran staked out showed how far apart the two sides remain even as both talked of winding down regional hostilities.

zh.title: 特朗普声称完全控制霍尔木兹海峡，要求伊朗赔偿
zh.summary: 特朗普通过声称美国控制权并要求伊朗赔偿来升级霍尔木兹海峡对峙，尽管华盛顿和德黑兰就缓和冲突的言论保持相反立场。

title: Stock futures are steady as investors weigh Iran, Hormuz deal prospects: Live updates
summary: Investors are monitoring potential progress toward reopening the Strait of Hormuz amid U.S.-Iran tensions. The market is balancing optimistic diplomatic signals against uncertainty about a broader resolution. This matters as Hormuz is a critical chokepoint for global oil supplies.
content: Investors weighed signs of progress toward reopening the Strait of Hormuz against doubts that the U.S. and Iran can reach a broader resolution to the conflict.

zh.title: 股市期货保持稳定，投资者权衡伊朗、霍尔木兹协议前景：实时更新
zh.summary: 投资者正在监测美伊紧张局势中霍尔木兹海峡重新开放的潜在进展。市场在乐观的外交信号和对更广泛解决方案的不确定性之间保持平衡。这很重要，因为霍尔木兹海峡是全球石油供应的关键咽喉。

title: Trump Media reports $238m loss as crypto falls
summary: Trump Media reported a $238 million loss, partly impacted by falling cryptocurrency valuations. The company plans to focus on its social media business and a premium service offering faster access to Trump's posts. This highlights ongoing monetization challenges amid volatile digital asset markets.
content: The firm says it will refocus on its social media mission, which includes a controversial service that sells faster access to Trump's market-moving posts.

zh.title: 特朗普媒体公司报告2.38亿美元亏损，加密货币下跌
zh.summary: 特朗普媒体公司报告了2.38亿美元的亏损，部分原因是加密货币估值下降。该公司计划专注于其社交媒体业务和提供更快访问特朗普帖子的高级服务。这突出了数字资产市场波动中持续的货币化挑战。

title: Rocket Lab reveals some big plans, but its stock is dropping on mixed earnings
summary: Rocket Lab announced European expansion plans and growing order backlog despite mixed quarterly earnings. The market reacted negatively, suggesting investor concerns about execution outweigh growth prospects. This reflects broader skepticism in the aerospace industry despite the company's operational progress.
content: The company is looking to expand its reach in Europe and building up its backlog.

zh.title: Rocket Lab透露宏大计划，但因混合收益股价下跌
zh.summary: Rocket Lab宣布了欧洲扩展计划和不断增长的订单积压，尽管季度收益参差不齐。市场反应消极，表明投资者对执行的担忧超过对增长前景的看好。这反映了航空航天业的广泛怀疑，尽管该公司运营进展良好。

title: This is the ZIP code with the hottest housing market in the country right now
summary: A particular ZIP code is experiencing exceptionally intense real-estate competition, according to Realtor.com's analysis of America's hottest housing market. The competitive environment presents significant challenges for buyers navigating aggressive bidding and elevated prices. This reflects broader trends in tight housing markets across the country.
content: Today’s residential real-estate market is not for the weak, observes one buyer in what Realtor.com is calling America’s hottest ZIP code.

zh.title: 这是目前全国房地产市场最火热的邮编
zh.summary: 根据Realtor.com对美国最火热房地产市场的分析，某个特定邮编区域正经历异常激烈的房地产竞争。竞争激烈的市场环境为应对咄咄逼人的竞价和高企房价的购房者带来了重大挑战。这反映了全国范围内紧张住房市场的更广泛趋势。
